notes._family: NOT KNOWABLE from the model name, and the reference's author says so plainly: « there are ADI-2's out there with three different DAC chips [...] whether ADI-2 Pro is always AKM chip or if ESS is also to be found there. It's a bit of a mess, since one needs to understand to check the serial number label ». Filed under AKM here until 2026-11-20 on no evidence at all. A model that spans chip families is a real case, not a gap: the honest value is unknown, and a USB identity will not fix it either, since the variants share one.
notes._modulator_order: Stated explicitly because the family no longer supplies one. Seven is the catalogue's default for multi-element switching arrays and the safe assumption here.
notes._technology: Stated here because this record has no chip family and the engine would otherwise assume it. It is safe to state: the reference's author says the ADI-2 exists with three different converter chips and names AKM and ESS among them, and every candidate is a delta-sigma part. So the TECHNOLOGY is known even though the FAMILY is not - which is exactly the case the family being optional exists for.

_note: Lot repris du catalogue JSON d'origine. Sa preuve est la chaîne `source` de la fiche : à éclater en preuves par champ au fur et à mesure, car une seule citation pour dix faits est le défaut connu de ce lot. `notes` porte les gloses que la fiche d'origine attachait à tel ou tel champ.
